lines.text: Jehu conspired against Joram, then drove his chariot to Jezreel, where Ahaziah king of Judah had come to see him.
Joram sent two horsemen to ask Jehu if he came in peace, and neither returned, so Joram rode out himself.
Jehu shot Joram between the shoulders and told Bidkar to throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Ahaziah fled toward Beth-haggan, was shot near Ibleam, died at Samaria, and his servants carried him to Jerusalem.
Eunuchs threw Jezebel down at Jehu's command, and Jehu said the word of the LORD through Elijah the Tishbite was fulfilled.
